description: Year two, batch one: formula-assisted editorial first-pass drafts, not approved or published. Requires originality, KJV and doctrinal review.

entries.title: Growing Daily in Christ
entries.reflection: Faith in God produces obedience even when outcomes are uncertain. Remember this when plans are delayed. Speak with kindness and clarity; keep a commitment you have made.
entries.prayer: Father, increase my faith when plans are delayed; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: A renewed heart turns to God rather than trusting outward activity. Remember this when work becomes demanding. Ask for wisdom from mature believers; choose forgiveness over bitterness.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my heart when work becomes demanding; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Holiness requires integrity in public and private decisions. Remember this when you have an opportunity to serve. Make peace where possible; recall a promise from Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, purify my choices when you have an opportunity to serve; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is near to those who call upon Him in trouble. Remember this when a neighbour asks for help. Show gratitude to someone who serves; thank God for a small mercy.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my hope when a neighbour asks for help; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Steady prayer makes room for gratitude and concern for others. Remember this when a promise is difficult to keep. Review your motives before proceeding; let your conduct reflect the gospel.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray when a promise is difficult to keep; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Repentance involves turning away from sin and trusting Jesus Christ. Remember this when your priorities are challenged. Let your conduct reflect the gospel; make peace where possible.
topics.prayer: Father, draw me to repentance when your priorities are challenged; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith in God produces obedience even when outcomes are uncertain. Remember this when plans are delayed. Speak with kindness and clarity; keep a commitment you have made.
topics.prayer: Father, increase my faith when plans are delayed; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Spirit empowers Christlike living and courageous witness. Remember this when you must make a choice. Choose a gentle answer over a sharp reply; ask what obedience would look like today.
topics.prayer: Father, empower my witness when you must make a choice; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Sharing Christ requires truthfulness and compassion. Remember this when you encounter disagreement. Thank God for a small mercy; offer practical help without seeking credit.
topics.prayer: Father, give me courage to share Christ when you encounter disagreement; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Love within the church should be patient and practical. Remember this when anxiety interrupts your thoughts. Pray before reacting to the situation; resist the urge to judge another person hastily.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with sincere love when anxiety interrupts your thoughts; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Hearing Scripture is incomplete without doing what it teaches. Remember this when you receive unexpected news. Resist the urge to judge another person hastily; choose a gentle answer over a sharp reply.
topics.prayer: Father, help me obey Your Word when you receive unexpected news; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wisdom begins with humble dependence upon God. Remember this when you need to forgive. Recall a promise from Scripture; review your motives before proceeding.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me wisdom when you need to forgive; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Watchfulness means remaining faithful while awaiting Christ. Remember this when you have time to reflect. Remember the needs of your community; ask for wisdom from mature believers.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me faithful when you have time to reflect; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Repentance involves turning away from sin and trusting Jesus Christ. Remember this when you encounter disagreement. Give attention to someone who needs encouragement; recall a promise from Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, draw me to repentance when you encounter disagreement; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith in God produces obedience even when outcomes are uncertain. Remember this when anxiety interrupts your thoughts. Keep a commitment you have made; thank God for a small mercy.
topics.prayer: Father, increase my faith when anxiety interrupts your thoughts; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Spirit empowers Christlike living and courageous witness. Remember this when you receive unexpected news. Act with honesty even if it is inconvenient; let your conduct reflect the gospel.
topics.prayer: Father, empower my witness when you receive unexpected news; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Sharing Christ requires truthfulness and compassion. Remember this when you need to forgive. Ask for wisdom from mature believers; make peace where possible.
topics.prayer: Father, give me courage to share Christ when you need to forgive; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Love within the church should be patient and practical. Remember this when you have time to reflect. Make peace where possible; keep a commitment you have made.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with sincere love when you have time to reflect; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Hearing Scripture is incomplete without doing what it teaches. Remember this when criticism is unfair. Show gratitude to someone who serves; ask what obedience would look like today.
topics.prayer: Father, help me obey Your Word when criticism is unfair; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wisdom begins with humble dependence upon God. Remember this when you feel overlooked. Review your motives before proceeding; offer practical help without seeking credit.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me wisdom when you feel overlooked; help me to honour You in this decision.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Watchfulness means remaining faithful while awaiting Christ. Remember this when an apology is needed. Let your conduct reflect the gospel; resist the urge to judge another person hastily.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me faithful when an apology is needed; help me to honour You in this decision.
